name: 94704 · Berkeley, CA
findings: ZIP 94704 (Berkeley) has 257 nonprofit organizations. 118 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94704 (Berkeley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
